title: 学术常用词（上）
goal: 掌握研究、变化和来源方面的学术常用词，并根据已给字母补全词形。
exam: TOEFL iBT（2026 年 1 月起的新版）· 阅读

points.label: 认识本课的学术常用词

body.p: 本课收 60 个各学科通用的词，分三组：研究过程，变化和数量，来源和产生。词性决定词在句中的位置。表中的中文义是例句里的用法。

body.box: Researchers analyze data from several sources. The results show a gradual increase.

body.p: analyze 是分析，data 是数据，sources 是来源，gradual 说明变化缓慢，increase 是增加。词义在单句里练，拼写在段落里练。

cards.title: 词汇表：研究过程
rows: These data come from several trials.
compare the lengths of two cables
measure the width of an opening
record the date of each trial
evaluate the accuracy of a model
test a hypothesis about word order
change one variable at a time
estimate the number of missing pages

cards.title: 词汇表：变化和数量
rows: an increase in the number of applications
a significant change in the schedule
a range from ten to twenty
the proportion of responses received online
a decrease in the error rate
the amount of liquid in a container
a downward trend in energy use

cards.title: 词汇表：来源和产生
rows: develop a method for sorting records
A pattern may emerge from repeated trials.
derive an estimate from the measurements
establish a link between two records
obtain permission to examine the records
The trial may yield useful evidence.
Water droplets form on the cold surface.
construct a model of the building
invent a device for measuring pressure
discover an error in the records

body.box: The notebooks provide evid____ about the ori___ of the practice. The researchers will esta_____ a timeline from these records.

body.p: evidence 是证据，共 8 个字母，已给 evid，补 ence。它是 provide 的宾语：笔记为研究这种做法提供证据。
origin 是起源，共 6 个字母，ori___ 补 gin。establish 是建立，共 9 个字母，esta_____ 补 blish。前一空是名词，后一空是动词。
词汇表里的 found 是动词原形，意思是创立，过去式是 founded：They founded an institute。find 的过去式也是 found，意思是找到：They found a notebook。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The investigators observed the insects without touching them or changing their surroundings.

items.stem: Which phrase is closest in meaning to observed in this sentence?
items.why: 依据是 without touching them or changing their surroundings。observed 是观察，即第一项 watched carefully。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The organization expanded its collection from one cabinet to three rooms.

items.stem: Which phrase best expresses expanded in this sentence?
items.why: 依据是 from one cabinet to three rooms。expanded 是扩大，即第二项 made it larger。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The report gives an estimate of the missing material because exact records are unavailable.

items.stem: What does estimate mean in this context?
options: An exact count of the material
items.why: 依据是 exact records are unavailable。没有精确记录，只能估计，即第三项 approximate calculation。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Most entries came from interviews, but a small proportion came from letters.

items.stem: What does proportion refer to here?
options: The total length of the letters
The share of all the entries
items.why: 依据是 Most entries 和 a small proportion 的对照。proportion 指在全部条目中占的比例，即第四项 share。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The technician kept the pressure constant during the entire trial.

items.stem: Which phrase is closest in meaning to constant here?
items.why: 依据是 kept the pressure constant during the entire trial。constant 是保持不变，即第一项 remaining at the same level。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The group hopes to derive a timetable from the dated photographs.

items.stem: What does derive mean in this sentence?
options: Plan a schedule for taking photos
items.why: 依据是 from the dated photographs。derive 是从照片中得出时间表，即第二项。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A class studies the layout of a small garden. Students obs{erve} how people use the paths, and the number of visitors is reco{rded} in a log. They com{pare} two entrances and mea{sure} the width of each path. Their sur{vey} asks which route visitors prefer. A clear majo{rity} choose the wider entrance. The class then tries to dev{elop} a new plan and red{uce} crowding near the gate. The plan may cre{ate} more room for movement without a large incr{ease} in the paved area.
notes: observe：observe 表示观察，后接 how people use the paths。
recorded：is recorded in a log 是被动语态，record 用过去分词。
compare：compare two entrances 表示比较两个入口。
measure：measure the width 表示测量宽度。
survey：这里的 survey 是调查，问访客选哪条路。
majority：majority 是多数，a majority 指一群访客，所以后面的 choose 用复数。
develop：develop a new plan 表示制定方案。
reduce：reduce crowding 表示减少拥挤。
create：create more room 表示创造更多空间。
increase：increase in the paved area 表示铺装面积增加。

groups.label: Fill in the missing letters.
groups.fill: A class examines measurements in a collection of recipes. The students ana{lyze} quantities in each instruction. The da{ta} are entered into a table. One met{hod} uses the same unit for every ingredient. A small sam{ple} of recipes is checked first. Students com{pare} the amounts and record the ra{nge} from the smallest to the largest value. They calculate the propo{rtion} of recipes with missing units and esti{mate} the missing quantities. Each original cookbook remains the sou{rce} from which they der{ive} their information.

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: A study of repair requests found only a gradual increase: the number rose slightly each month.

items.stem: Which phrase best expresses gradual in this context?
items.why: 依据是 rose slightly each month。gradual 是逐步发生，即第一项 happening in small steps。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The test produced a useful finding: the thicker seal prevented more leakage.

options: The tool used during the test
The place where the test occurred
The result learned from the test
The rule followed before the test
items.why: 依据是冒号后的 the thicker seal prevented more leakage。finding 是从测试中得到的结果，即第三项。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The majority of respondents preferred a printed brochure; fewer than half chose a website.

items.stem: What does majority indicate in this sentence?
options: More than half of the group
The earliest members of the group
items.why: 依据是 fewer than half chose a website。majority 指超过一半，即第二项，不是所有人。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: Volunteers plan to found a society devoted to the history of local games.

items.stem: Which phrase is closest in meaning to found here?
items.why: 依据是 plan to found a society。这里的 found 是动词原形，意思是创立，即第四项。第一项把它当成了 find 的过去式。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The origin of the pattern is uncertain, although later copies survive in several collections.

items.stem: What does origin refer to here?
options: Where the pattern first came from
How quickly the copies were made
items.why: 依据是 origin 和 later copies 的先后对照。origin 指最初的来源，即第一项。

groups.label: Read the text.
groups.text: The new procedure may yield a clearer image than the earlier method.

items.stem: Which verb is closest in meaning to yield in this context?
items.why: 依据是 yield a clearer image。yield 是产生某种结果，可以换成第三项 produce。
